heading: Infosys Dividend 2026: Understanding Your Payout and Returns
tldr: Infosys announced an interim dividend of ₹26 per equity share for FY27 on October 23.
The record date for this interim dividend is set for tomorrow, November 3, 2026.
Shareholders holding Infosys shares by the record date will be eligible for the dividend.
Dividends are subject to taxation as per the Income Tax Act, 1961, for resident and non-resident Indians.
Understanding dividend yield and payout history helps investors gauge a company's financial health and return policy.
caption:
Got Infosys shares? Good news! Infosys announced a ₹26 dividend per share, and tomorrow, November 3, 2026, is the last day to own shares to get it. This means extra money for you!
